title: Writing templates
content: Fikrni aniqlang. Har asosiy xatboshida bitta fikrni sabab va misol bilan rivojlantiring. Masalan: Online learning suits working adults because lessons can fit around shifts. For example, a nurse can review a recorded lesson after work. Mashq: 15 daqiqada ikkita asosiy xatboshi yozing.

title: Speaking practice
content: Describe a place where you study well. Where is it? What helps you focus there? How has your routine changed? 30 soniya tayyorlaning, 60 soniya gapiring. Keyin bir noaniq joyni aniq misol bilan qayta ayting.

title: Useful phrases
content: Make steady progress — muntazam o‘sish. Set aside time — vaqt ajratish. Put something into practice — biror narsani amalda qo‘llash. Har bir iborani o‘zingiz haqingizdagi bitta gapda ishlating.

title: Listening drills
content: Birinchi tinglashda suhbatning maqsadini aniqlang. Ikkinchisida nomzoddan so‘ralgan mavzu va javob qachon berilishini yozing.

title: Reading for evidence
content: The library extended its weekend hours after students requested a quiet study space. Weekday hours stayed the same. Savol: Kutubxona qaysi paytda ish vaqtini uzaytirdi va nima sababdan? Har javob uchun matndan aniq dalil toping.

title: Grammar repair
content: Use since for a starting point and for for a duration. I have studied here since September. I have studied here for three months. O‘zingiz haqingizda har biriga ikki misol yozing.
